text:
rachel (People Ops): Quick brainstorm  were piloting "Kindness Kits" as micro-recognition packs (sticker, note card, small snack) for folks nominated via the spot-award form. Need to lock pack SKU, shipping rules, and manager signoff for addresses. Anyone got vendor recs or constraints? :package:
omar (Events): Love it. For a pilot suggest 50 kits. Keep contents low-cost and desk-friendly. I have a sample vendor (PackPal) who does 5-7 day turnarounds. Will share sample SKUs.
kelly (Finance): Budget thumbs-up for pilot but need unit cost + shipping estimate. Also confirm if kits counted as taxable benefits in recipient country (we may treat as de minimis). Please capture recipient country in the form.
jules (Facilities): If we do any in-office drop-offs, I can coordinate a lobby table. For remote folks we need reliable address capture and opt-in. Also watch for perishable items across regions.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: "Collect final SKU list" on 2215432135. :robot_face:
rachel (People Ops): Action items: Omar - share vendor SKU links by EOD; Kelly - signoff once you have cost estimate; Jules - draft in-office drop plan; I'll update nomination form to include address opt-in and country. We'll cap physical to US/CA/UK for pilot to avoid customs.
omar (Events): Shared PackPal link in DM, will attach sample contents: enamel sticker, 2nd gen thank-you card, granola bar, branded tea bag. Estimated cost $12-15/unit plus shipping.
kelly (Finance): If $15/unit + avg $7 shipping, 50 kits = ~$1100. Ok for pilot. Please include invoice and PO flow for PackPal.
rachel (People Ops): Great. I'll update the form and post a short internal announcement template. Pilot timeline: launch nominations next Mon, ship kits end of month. We'll measure nomination rate and redemption acceptance. Thanks team :heart:
